description: Stable Audio 3 on CPU via LiteRT/TFLite - text-to-audio, audio-to-audio, and inpainting with no PyTorch at runtime
notes: Model weights are NOT bundled. They lazy-download from HuggingFace
(stabilityai/stable-audio-3-optimized) on first use: ~2.3 GB for the small
DiTs, ~9.5 GB for medium. Anonymous downloads are rate-limited - run
'huggingface-cli login' with a free read token to lift the cap.
sa3-gradio          # browser UI (installs gradio extras on first run)
Weights are governed by the Stability AI Community License:
Persisted across upgrades: .venv, models/tflite, output, loras.
If HuggingFace downloads fail with path-length errors, enable Windows long
paths once from an admin PowerShell, then restart your terminal:
ffmpeg is optional - only needed for mp3 / 24-bit / non-44.1kHz --init-audio
pre_install: # Upstream ships no Windows twin of the ./sa3-gradio shell wrapper; make one.
# Must run before create_shims, which is why this is pre_install, not post_install.
# The gradio UI extras (gradio, pillow, soundfile) are deliberately kept OUT of the
# base install -- they pull a large dependency tree that CLI-only users never touch.
# This wrapper installs them into .venv on first use, mirroring what upstream's
# ./sa3-gradio bash script does, so the UI stays opt-in but self-healing.
'echo error: .venv not found. Run: scoop reset sa3_tflite 1>&2',
'echo Installing gradio UI extras into .venv - this happens once...',
post_install: # Runs AFTER persist_data, so $dir\.venv is already a junction into the
# persist dir on upgrades - an existing venv is reused, not rebuilt.
Write-Host 'Creating Python 3.11 venv via uv (ai-edge-litert has no 3.14 wheels)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
error 'Failed to create the .venv - is uv working? Try: uv python install 3.11'
Write-Host 'Installing runtime deps into the venv...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { error 'uv pip install failed'; return }
